secrets.name: The Room Behind the Dollhouse
secrets.text: You crawl out of the little library into one of its rooms, the same wallpaper, the same lamp, the same chair. Except that this one is your size. Or you are its.

meta.label: The Dollhouse
meta.blurb: Along the north wall somebody has built the library again, at a tenth of the size, and left all its lamps on. Its front door is just big enough, if you kneel.
